name: low-balance event
audit_reference_only: A; no model target selection or tuning on A

cohort.provenance: Explicit fixed IDs from reviewed account_eligibility.csv; that earlier selection used >=3 conservative assessable months. This historical membership is retained by user instruction, not reapplied as an active month filter.
cohort.retrospective_selection_limitation: Full-source cohort ascertainment is not prospective admission or evidence of whole-bank generalization.

origin: First calendar day of target month at 00:00; monthly predictors strictly earlier.

reference_scale.eligible_debits: Known operation and type VYDAJ or VYBER; includes fees and debt payments, not a discretionary-spending map.

coverage.meaning: Retrospective outcome availability only; absent observed low snapshots do not prove no unobserved dips.

secondary_binary_event.definition: Any observed post-transaction balance / fixed reference scale < 0.05 on a date strictly before the target month last calendar day.
secondary_binary_event.status_rule: User-authorized aggregate check: exploratory when test B positive account-months <20. No threshold/split changes follow this count.

continuous_primary.definition: Exact last-calendar-day closing balance / reference scale known at prediction origin.
continuous_primary.population: All 832 registered accounts; publish exact target availability and explicit unscorable counts by assigned period.
continuous_primary.measurement: Use a unique/equal observed balance or unique terminal vertex of a connected valid signed-ledger Euler trail. No highest-trans_id or file-order assumption.
continuous_primary.unresolved: Preserve min/max last-day snapshot bounds; no midpoint/last-observation carry-forward, no invented scalar target. Exclude unresolved months from exact point error, not accounts from registry.
continuous_primary.derived_warning: Predicted month-end ratio <0.05, evaluated against measured month-end ratio <0.05; distinct from secondary any-earlier low-balance event.

baselines.last_month_ratio: Previous exact month-end closing balance / current known reference scale (persistence on the same target denominator).
baselines.pace_rule: (Previous exact closing balance + median observed net monthly cash flow over previous 3 months) / current reference; cash flow retains bank-generated credits.
baselines.logistic_regression: Exploratory classifier for selected binary B only; not a regressor for the continuous primary target.
baselines.gradient_boosting: Regressor for the continuous primary target; separate exploratory classifier for selected B if later authorized.
baselines.availability: Report each baseline availability; paired comparisons use common exact-target/input cases without hiding missing accounts.

feature_contract.allowed: Past monthly ratios/shares or training-fitted z-scores; all inputs known strictly before origin.
feature_contract.recurrent_models: No Berka daily LSTM or GRU; no recurrent Berka model in this protocol.
feature_contract.currency: CZK retained for source arithmetic only; no raw-money predictor or PKR wallet mixing.
feature_contract.unknown_operations: Keep for balance/cash-flow; exclude from spending/anomaly/persona numerators and denominators.

split.cutoff_rule: Every outcome horizon entirely inside its assigned period; past lookback may cross year boundaries only for the same assigned account.
split.test_usage_this_step: Aggregate positive month/account counts for A and B only, plus target availability; no prediction metrics, tuning or per-row test targets exported.

future_evaluation.warning: Fixed predicted-ratio cutoff 0.05 versus month-end low-balance truth; report separately from B.

bootstrap.resampling_unit: Account cluster within each partition; retain all months and use the same draws for paired baseline differences.
bootstrap.account_weighting: Equal account weight; calculate monthly mean loss within account then aggregate accounts.
bootstrap.undefined_binary_draws: Record count of undefined single-class replicates; never resample until positives appear. If >5% undefined, mark that metric CI unreliable/unavailable.
bootstrap.limitation: Conditional on observed bank/calendar periods; not evidence of generalization to student finances.
